purpose: US-equity adaptation layer for the frozen EXPERIMENTAL-DETECTORS-1 parameters plus one new gap detector. Thresholds were chosen before any outcome was observed; they are not tuned or validated.

equity_adaptation_of_v1.engine: independent reimplementation from trading/pilot/README.md; equivalence to the original runner.py is UNVERIFIED because that code was not available
equity_adaptation_of_v1.cohort: EXCLUDED from the authoritative v1 pilot cohort (trading/pilot/runs/). Sample and replay runs are excluded from any performance denominator.
equity_adaptation_of_v1.session_class: RTH only (09:30-16:00 America/New_York, early close 13:00); PRE/POST bars never enter windows or baselines

dataset_requirements.volume_scope_and_unit: declared (not 'unknown') for volume-dependent detectors; one scope per dataset

interpretations_needing_review: touch separation: two ceiling touches count when their bar indices differ by at least touch_separation_bars (3)
pivot low: strictly lower than each of the 2 bars on each side; equal lows are not pivots
compression window may span one declared session break only at exact session boundaries (last RTH slot -> first RTH slot of the next session)
ignition baseline: walk back through prior sessions (most recent first, at most 40 sessions) collecting sessions whose three matching RTH slots are all usable; stop at 20; require at least 10
freshness: latest usable RTH bar end must be within maximum_bar_age_seconds of the scan cutoff; outside RTH this makes the detector INSUFFICIENT_DATA (market closed), not NO_SIGNAL
benchmark: the instrument's declared benchmark_symbol from the same dataset; every window timestamp must have a usable benchmark bar

eq_gap.definition: Regular-session opening gap: open of the first RTH bar of the cutoff's session versus close of the final RTH bar of the previous session.

first_bar_matched_volume.baseline: median volume of the same first RTH slot over the most recent 10-20 prior sessions with a usable first bar (same dataset/scope/unit)

eq_gap.direction: upside only (consistent with IGNITION); downside gaps are not detected by this version
eq_gap.freshness: same maximum_bar_age_seconds as v1 (900 s) for the latest usable bar
eq_gap.premarket: excluded; the gap is measured between regular-session prints only
